$schema_notes: The hard set. Kept apart from questions.json so the published numbers over
the original 70 stay comparable across arms — mixing a harder corpus into
the same denominator would move every metric for reasons that have nothing
to do with the mechanism being measured.
Two documents, two different ways of being difficult.
celiskili-seyahat-tr contradicts itself, which is what real policies do once
an endorsement has been bolted onto a base wording. For those questions the
correct behaviour is to surface BOTH clauses and say the document is not
consistent. Nothing in the system currently produces that answer, so
expected_evidence lists both sides: recall then measures the mechanical
prerequisite — did both halves of the contradiction reach the model — and
what it does with them is read by hand and reported honestly.
iki-sutun-kasko-tr is ordinary prose in two columns. The parser sorts blocks
by (top, x0), which interleaves the columns line by line, so these questions
test whether an answer survives text that has been shuffled into nonsense.

questions.question: Yurt dışında acil tedavi görürsem masrafım karşılanıyor mu?
expected_evidence: Yurt dışında gerçekleşen her türlü tedavi gideri
questions.expected_answer_summary: The document says both. Article 1.1 and Article 2 grant 50.000 EUR of foreign emergency treatment; Article 5.1 excludes all foreign treatment outright. Neither clause qualifies the other.
questions.notes: The flat contradiction, and the one that matters most. An answer citing only the table is wrong in the most dangerous way available: correct, verbatim, and half the document.

questions.question: Ameliyat için ödenecek azami tutar nedir?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Two figures, both stated: the schedule says 100.000 TL and Article 3 says 75.000 TL. The document does not say which governs.
questions.notes: A numeric contradiction rather than a coverage one. Whichever figure an answer picks, it is citable — which is exactly why picking one is the failure.

questions.question: Bagaj kaybı teminatım hâlâ geçerli mi?
questions.expected_answer_summary: No. The schedule lists 1.500 EUR, but the endorsement of 01.06.2026 removes the cover.
questions.notes: The control for the two above: this one LOOKS like a contradiction and is not. The endorsement explicitly amends, and the document says which wins. An answer that calls this a contradiction is over-triggering.

questions.question: Poliçede bekleme süresi var mı, ne kadar?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Seven days from inception, except for emergencies.
questions.notes: An uncomplicated question in a complicated document, so a collapse on the others cannot be blamed on the document being hard to read at all.

questions.question: Diş tedavisi bu poliçe kapsamında mı?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The policy never mentions dental treatment, in either the schedule or the exclusions.
questions.notes: A refusal in a document full of contradictions. If the contradictions make the system hedge everything, this is where over-refusal shows up.

questions.question: Yurt içi acil tedavi limiti ve muafiyeti nedir?
questions.notes: Sits one row away from the contradicted line in the same table. Tests whether the contradiction contaminates its neighbours.

questions.question: Her bir hasar için muafiyet ne kadar?
questions.expected_answer_summary: 4.000 TL per claim, waived for glass damage.
questions.notes: The parser interleaves the two columns, so the sentence carrying this figure arrives spliced together with an unrelated one from the other column.

questions.question: Araçtan çalınan kişisel eşyalarım karşılanıyor mu?
expected_evidence: kişisel eşyalar bu poliçe kapsamında değildir
questions.expected_answer_summary: No. Personal effects stolen from the vehicle are outside the policy; factory-fitted audio and video equipment is inside it.
questions.notes: A negative answer that is stated in the document, which is different from a refusal and must not be reported as one.

questions.question: Hasarı kaç gün içinde bildirmem gerekiyor ve geç kalırsam ne olur?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Five working days. A late notice does not void the claim, but the insured carries whatever additional loss the delay caused.
questions.notes: Two spans from consecutive paragraphs of the same article — which the column interleaving separates by a column's worth of unrelated text.

questions.question: Anahtarı araçta unutursam hırsızlık teminatı geçerli mi?
questions.expected_answer_summary: No. The theft cover does not apply if the key was left in the vehicle.
questions.notes: The clause sits at the end of a paragraph, which is where interleaving does the most damage — the next line belongs to the other column.

questions.question: Aracım hasarlıyken ikame araç veriliyor mu?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The policy says nothing about a courtesy or replacement vehicle.
questions.notes: Refusal has to survive scrambled text too. Interleaved prose is a rich source of plausible-looking fragments to over-read.

questions.question: Alkollü araç kullanımı ve yarışa katılma teminat kapsamında mı?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Neither. Both are listed among the exclusions in Article 5.
questions.notes: A list, which the two-column flow splits across the column boundary.
